title: Energy Routes, Trade Corridors, and Geography
grammar: Diplomatic verbs governing sublative and allative (törekszik -ra/-re, hozzájárul -hoz/-hez)
goal: I can analyze Central Europe's landlocked geography and the strategic importance of North-South transport and energy corridors.
I can master verbs governing the sublative (-ra/-re) and allative (-hoz/-hez/-höz) in geopolitical discourse.
I can discuss energy diversification, gas interconnectors, LNG terminals, and infrastructure investments.
